AARAMBH LEARNING FOR BEGINNERS
Welcome to the official channel of Aarambh For beginners "EducationalVideos" ! 
Aarambh is a free education initiative to educate students all around the world through online learning that is home based school. 
I believe that e-learning makes education an interactive, engaging, and fun activity, thereby helping in higher and long-term knowledge retention.
My channel consists of e-learning videos for Class 1to 10 school children on, English, Science, Social Studies, Environmental Science, G.K, Essays & Speeches  and much more.
